[[Spear Pillar]] (by {{adv|Diamond}}) |gender=Gender unknown |ability={{a|Slow Start}} |nature=Lax |type1=Normal |media=special |epnum=PS400 |pokemonname=Regigigas |epname=Bogging Down Quagsire |catchepnum=PS416 |catchepname=Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI{{tt|*|Originally caught prior to PS460}} |released=yes |releaseep=PS400 |releasename=Prior to Bogging Down Quagsire |prevonum=486 |evo1num=486 |noevo=incap |current=[[Party|With Diamond]] |va=no }} '''Reg''' (Japanese: '''ぎー''' ''Gī'') is a {{p|Regigigas}} that {{adv|Diamond}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. Prior to the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}, Reg was owned by [[Palmer]], but was released soon after. As of ''[[PS434|The Final Dimensional Duel IV]]'', it is at [[level]] 75, and its [[Characteristic]] is that it has a "sturdy body." ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== =====Prior to the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== At some point in the past, Regigigas created the three [[legendary giants]] to resemble its own image. ====={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===== [[File:Palmer Regigigas Adventures.png|thumb|200px|left|Regigigas under Palmer's ownership]] Prior to ''[[PS460|All About Arceus IX]]'', Reg was awakened by [[Palmer]] with the help of [[Brandon]]'s [[Brandon's legendary giants#Pokémon Adventures|legendary giants]] so that it could be used to stop a legendary crisis in [[Sinnoh]] in the case that there was one. Since it was not necessary at the time, Palmer {{pkmn2|released}} it back into [[Snowpoint Temple]]. ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== [[File:Reg appearing to Diamond.png|thumb|200px|Reg appearing to Diamond]] Reg first appeared at the Snowpoint Temple as a silhouette in ''[[PS400|Bogging Down Quagsire]]'' after {{adv|Platinum}}, [[Maylene]], and [[Candice]] ended up camping there after their defeat at the hands of [[Jupiter]]. It let loose a growling noise that startled Platinum, causing her to pull out a {{i|Poké Ball}} in case it was a wild Pokémon that she would need to catch for their safety; however, she fell unconscious from her injuries and the Poké Ball fell and rolled towards Regigigas, who went inside the Poké Ball. In ''[[PS415|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia V]]'', during the final battle with [[Cyrus]] on the [[Spear Pillar]], Regigigas appeared from out of Platinum's bag to save {{adv|Diamond}} and {{p|Mamoswine|Moo}} from entering a black hole. After saving him, Regigigas decided to choose Diamond as its {{pkmn|Trainer}} and the two go to battle against {{adv|Pokémon of myth|Dialga and Palkia}}. Reg managed to grab Dialga and Palkia and pin them down so that the black hole they created while fighting would not be able to widen any further. Although it was able to stop them briefly, Dialga and Palkia were encouraged by Cyrus to fight even harder. The power they expelled became too great for Reg to handle and it was sent flying and defeated. Later, it helped to carry several [[Gym Leader]]s to a hospital after the battle had ended. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== [[File:Diamond and Reg.png|thumb|200px|left|Reg and Diamond]] In ''[[PS430|Unplugging Rotom (Heat, Wash, Mow, Fan, Frost)]]'', Diamond revealed that even though Reg was now his Pokémon, it refused to come out of its Poké Ball, and he enlisted the help of [[Dr. Footstep]] to see if he could read its footprints to figure out what is wrong with it. [[PS431|Soon after]], a {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Giratina}} arrived from the [[Distortion World]] and begun wreaking havoc on [[Eterna City]]. Reg quickly let itself out from its Poké Ball to battle the Renegade Pokémon. However, it was soon forced to switch opponents when it was attacked by [[Charon]]'s {{p|Heatran}}. The Lava Dome Pokémon proved to be a tough opponent with its strength and {{type|Fire}} moves, but Reg managed to deal heavy damage with its {{m|Crush Grip}} and nearly defeats it. [[File:Sinnoh Legendary Pokémon Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Regigigas battling Heatran]] In ''[[PS433|The Final Dimensional Duel III]]'', when Diamond was attacked and seemingly killed by a {{m|Shadow Force}} from Giratina after pushing {{adv|Pearl}} out of the way of the attack, Reg suddenly turned around and appeared to leave. However, Reg quickly returned and revealed that it only left to bring the appliances to allow {{TP|Diamond|Rotom}} to change forms and attack Charon. When Giratina tried to attack it from behind, Reg simply {{m|Rock Slide|tossed}} it on Heatran and throws a large pile of {{m|Icy Wind|snow}} on the two. When Pearl traveled to the Distortion World, he held Reg's Poké Ball since Diamond had mysteriously disappeared beforehand. In ''[[PS439|The Final Dimensional Duel IX]]'', at the Distortion World, Charon sent Heatran out to attack Diamond and Pearl, causing Reg to come out of its Poké Ball once again to fight it a second time. As their battle continued, several other [[Legendary Pokémon]] joined the fight. During the battle, Reg, along with several others, were put to {{status|sleep}} by {{p|Darkrai}}'s {{m|Dark Void}}; however, {{p|Shaymin}} managed to save them by turning their [[Ability|Abilities]] to {{a|Insomnia}} with {{m|Worry Seed}}, saving them from Giratina's {{m|Dragon Pulse}}. The battle with Giratina ended when it attempts to escape, leaving only the Pokémon that could fly to be able to chase it back into the real world. After Charon and Giratina were defeated, Reg, along with the other Legendary Pokémon, emerged from the Distortion World with [[Paka and Uji]] in its hands. It was then revealed to have chosen to stay as a part of Diamond's team. ====Personality and characteristics==== Little is known about Reg's personality, as it displays no facial expression and only appears during times of grave crisis that it deems as threatening towards the entire [[Sinnoh]] region. In these cases, Reg is capable of emerging from its {{i|Poké Ball}} by itself in order to intervene, without the command of its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. In its few appearances, [[Dr. Footstep]] analyzed its footprints which showed Reg's loyalty to Sinnoh and willingness to protect the peace, as well as deep lamentation for {{adv|Diamond}} when he was supposedly killed by {{DL|Pokémon of myth (Adventures)|Giratina}}'s {{m|Shadow Force}}. As a [[Legendary Pokémon]], Reg has demonstrated immense strength, which allows it to take on other Legendary Pokémon and stop them in their tracks, although it can get worn out over prolonged battling. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Normal||Reg {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Crush Grip|1=Icy Wind|2=Rock Slide}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Crush Grip|1=Icy Wind|2=Rock Slide}}}} {{anmov|Normal|Crush Grip|PS432|The Final Dimensional Duel II}} {{anmov|Rock|Rock Slide|PS434|The Final Dimensional Duel IV}} {{anmov|Ice|Icy Wind|PS434|The Final Dimensional Duel IV}} {{anmov/f|Normal}} ==In the games== ===In the [[core series]]=== Palmer's Regigigas appears in {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}} and {{g|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}} in the {{si|Battle Tower}} on the 49th consecutive battle, and in {{game|Platinum}}, {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s|HeartGold, and SoulSilver}} when battled for the [[Commemorative print|Gold Print]].
